settings.label: Customer count (trusted counter)
settings.info: Change it here once and every page updates.

settings.label: Products shown first
settings.info: Every product carousel and product grid that shows a collection puts these first (in this order, when they are in that collection), then the rest. A carousel with its own Products list keeps that order.

settings.content: How to use it: copy [customers] (with the square brackets) into any heading, eyebrow, text, button, review, FAQ or announcement, on any page or in the header/footer. It shows the number above. Example: "Trusted by [customers] Filipino men" → "Trusted by 100,000+ Filipino men".

settings.label: Page side margin (desktop)
settings.info: Space between the screen/page frame edge and the content. Header icons line up with it.

settings.label: Full-width buttons on mobile
settings.info: Every Zenith button (hero, banners, category cards, product cards…) spans the full width on phones.

settings.label: Background behind transparent product photos
settings.info: PNG product photos (e.g. a cut-out jar) sit on the background below on product cards, the product page, the featured product and the cart. JPG photos are not affected.

settings.label: Dark Judge.me review style
settings.info: Loads assets/zenith-judgeme.css on every page: dark cards, gold stars, 5-column grid. Turn off to go back to the app's own look (plus the Zenith · Reviews section settings).

settings.label: Show compare-at prices outside the cart
settings.info: Off: product pages, product cards and featured products show only the selling price (the % OFF badges stay). The cart page and cart drawer always show the struck compare-at price.

settings.content: Shown on every line in the cart drawer.

settings.label: Show the original price
settings.info: Strikes through the product's compare-at price so the discount stays visible while they check out.

settings.label: Savings label
settings.info: [amount] is replaced by what that line saves. Leave blank to hide it.

settings.content: Write [free_shipping] or [shipping_fee] in any text on the store — trust rows, announcement bar, anywhere — and the figures below are printed.

settings.label: Free shipping over
settings.info: In pesos, no symbol. Must match your real rule in Settings → Shipping. Set to 0 to hide the cart bar.

settings.label: Free shipping over (while a promotion runs)
settings.info: Takes over whenever Zenith · Promo → "Promotion is running" is on and the countdown has not passed. Set to 0 to keep the figure above during promotions.

settings.label: Flat shipping fee below that
settings.info: In pesos, no symbol. Printed by [shipping_fee] and by the bundle card ribbons.

settings.label: Shipping amount source
settings.info: Shopify shipping rates: the cart's Shipping and Total lines show the cheapest rate from Settings → Shipping and delivery for the address below (the flat fee above shows for a moment while it loads). The free shipping amounts above still drive the cart bar.

settings.label: Shipping rate country
settings.info: Country code (PH) or name (Philippines) used to look up the rate.

settings.label: Shipping rate region
settings.info: Required for the Philippines (Shopify won't quote a rate without a region and postal code), e.g. Metro Manila.

settings.label: Shipping rate postal code
settings.info: Required for the Philippines, e.g. 1000.

settings.label: Cart bar — still short
settings.info: [amount] is what is left to spend; [fee] is the flat fee. Blank hides the bar's text.

settings.content: Panel at the top of the cart drawer and cart page: a box with what is unlocked and how far the next goal is, then a checkpoint per goal (free shipping, then each % off tier). Display only — checkout applies the automatic discounts in Admin → Discounts. Once a discount applies, the summary chip shows the % Shopify actually gave.

settings.label: Show the % off tiers
settings.info: Turn off when the tier discounts in Admin → Discounts are paused or ended — the theme cannot see that on its own.

settings.content: Up to 5 tiers. Enter the same spend and % as each automatic discount in Admin → Discounts (e.g. a new 50% promo → change the % here too). Leave a tier empty or 0 to hide it. Keep them in ascending spend order, above the free shipping amount.

settings.label: Tier name
settings.info: [percent] = the tier %. Used on the checkpoints, in the message and on the summary chip.

settings.label: Free shipping name
settings.info: Lower case: it is used mid-sentence. The list capitalises it.

settings.label: Title — nothing unlocked yet
settings.info: [offer] = the next goal.

settings.label: Title — something unlocked
settings.info: [offer] = everything unlocked so far, e.g. "Free Shipping + 10% Off".

settings.label: Message — next goal
settings.info: [amount] = what is left to spend, [offer] = the next goal.

settings.content: Automatic: Shopify recommends products for what is in the cart (complementary products from the Search & Discovery app first, then Shopify's own picks), skipping anything already in the cart. Recommendations need some store traffic/orders before Shopify has data; complementary products can be set by hand in the Search & Discovery app.

settings.label: Show "Best used with"
settings.info: Shows in the cart drawer and on the cart page.

settings.label: Most products shown
settings.info: Related products from the collections of what is in the cart, up to this many; at least 1 (from other collections when nothing related is left). Nothing when the cart is empty.

settings.content: Replaces Estimated total in the cart drawer and on the cart page. Purchase discount shows while the tiers are on, or whenever a discount applies. Below the free shipping amount, Shipping shows the flat fee and Total includes it.

settings.label: Shipping
settings.info: While a promotion runs.

settings.label: Shipping — not reached, no flat fee

settings.content: Cart drawer and cart page. Off: − / + show as plain characters and the bin as the word "Remove", so the buttons keep working.
One promo for the whole store. Every "Zenith · Promo banner" section set to "Global promo" (and the hero countdown strip, if set to use it) shows this content — edit once, it updates everywhere.

settings.label: Promotion is running
settings.info: On: sections whose "Show" setting is "Only while the promotion runs" appear (promo banners) and sections set to "Only when no promotion runs" are hidden (homepage hero). Off: the reverse.

settings.label: End the promotion automatically at the countdown end
settings.info: After the end date/time below, the store switches back as if the promotion were off.

settings.label: Text
settings.default: Bundles and deals built for value. Here for a moment, then gone.

settings.label: Button product
settings.info: Optional. When set, the button adds this product to the cart or opens its page, instead of the Button link. A product picked on a banner section wins over this one.

settings.label: Background image
settings.info: "Background image" banner layout only: fills the banner behind the text. Recommended 2752 × 640px.

settings.label: Product image
settings.info: "Split" banner layout (default): the photo beside the colour panel, cropped to fill — recommended 1400 × 700px. "Background image" layout: optional transparent PNG beside the text.

settings.label: End date
settings.info: Format YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty to hide the countdown everywhere.

settings.label: End time
settings.info: 24-hour HH:MM

settings.label: Question
settings.default: What makes Zenith different from other men’s grooming brands?

settings.label: Answer
settings.default: Zenith is made for Filipino men and Philippine weather. Every product is FDA-notified, the ingredients are named on the label, and the routine is short enough to keep.

settings.label: Answer
settings.default: Men who want a short routine that works with heat and sweat. Most Zenith customers are Filipino men over 35.

settings.label: Question
settings.default: How long should I use Zenith before I judge it?

settings.label: Answer
settings.default: Use it as directed every day and give one full product a fair run before you decide. Skin care and hair care both take time. Full guarantee terms are on the Refunds and Returns page.

settings.label: Question
settings.default: Can I use Zenith products together?

settings.label: Answer
settings.default: Yes. Cleanser and day cream in the morning, tallow cream at night, shampoo in the shower, spray on a clean dry scalp before bed. The directions are on every label.

settings.label: Question
settings.default: Can I use Zenith if my skin is sensitive?

settings.label: Answer
settings.default: Check the full ingredient list on the product page first. Start with a small amount. If anything feels wrong, stop and message us.

settings.label: Question
settings.default: What is beef tallow and why is it in your skincare?

settings.label: Answer
settings.default: Beef tallow is rendered beef fat. It is the base of the Zenith Anti-Aging Tallow Cream, Cleanser and Day Cream SPF 30. The full ingredient list is on every product page.

settings.label: Answer
settings.default: Shipping fees vary by location and promotion. Check the product page or your cart for the latest.

settings.label: Answer
settings.default: Metro Manila orders arrive in about 3 days. Visayas and Mindanao in 3 to 7 days.

settings.label: Answer
settings.default: Every order carries the Zenith Money-Back Guarantee. Skin products are covered for 30 days and hair products for 60 days. Full terms on our Refunds and Returns page.
